responsibility: Declares the symbolic executor's foundational bit-level IR. It defines the value_type discriminator, the abstract value_bit base class, concrete leaf nodes for symbolic and constant bits, and bit_expression subclasses for bitwise, shift, arithmetic, and complement operations, along with copy/print interfaces and operand accessors; these classes are the data structures used by sym-exec state to store variable values and build symbolic per-bit expression trees from GCC tree operations.
same_name_distinction: Defines the core symbolic-execution bit/value class hierarchy and expression node declarations used across the module. Unlike sym-exec-expression.cc, this header establishes the IR types, enums, and method signatures, but not the concrete constructor, copy, destructor, accessor, or print implementations.
